note: Why each FINAL RULE has no coverage claim yet. Only rules with zero claims belong here; once a rule gets its first claim, its entry must be removed or the check fails. Verified by scripts/check-rule-coverage.mjs and test/rule-coverage.test.ts.

statusMeaning.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no code enforces this rule. evidence names what was searched and found absent.
statusMeaning.IMPLEMENTED_UNMAPPED: code enforces it and a test exercises it; only the coversRule claim is missing.
statusMeaning.IMPLEMENTED_UNTESTED: code exists but no test exercises the rule's conditions.
statusMeaning.NOT_CODE_VERIFIABLE: a rule about how the design document or the slicing process is written, not about runtime behaviour.

EXPORT_FIELD_ALLOWLIST_IS_CORE_OWNED_EXP.detail: no source file references exposureTier or an export allowlist. S5 is unimplemented.

EXPORT_FIELD_PATH_IS_EXPLICIT_LEAF_WITHO.detail: no export field path matcher exists.

S5_EXPORT_SEAM_USES_SANITIZED_SUMMARY_ON.detail: no source file references sanitize. The S5 seam has no code.

REDACTION_PATTERN_IS_LINEAR_TIME_REGEX_S.detail: the only occurrence of redaction in src is a comment in run-record.ts explaining why the record exists separately from an export.

REDACTION_RULE_FAILURE_BLOCKS_EXPORT.detail: neither redaction nor export is implemented, so the blocking relation has nothing to enforce.

SYSTEM_POLICY_AUTO_REVIEW_DECISION_IS_BO.detail: every RUN_REVIEW_DECIDED path requires a human local review import. No system-policy automatic decision exists to bound.

CORRECTIVE_EVENT_REQUIRES_VALID_LEDGER_A.detail: supersede and invalidate references are read during replay, but no command appends a corrective event.

POLICY_RULE_ID_IS_UNIQUE_WITH_REF_RECORD.detail: no named policy rules exist to have ids: definedByRef appears nowhere in src, and nothing parses or uniqueness-checks a rule id across the Core and Profile id space. The policies block itself IS read as of 3fbe0b5 (loadCommandPolicy, loadHarnessPolicy), but those are fixed known keys, not id-bearing rules.

PROFILE_EFFECTIVE_POLICY_IS_DERIVED.detail: effectivePolicy is derived and hashed in the Run Plan and is what path enforcement reads, but no test asserts the derivation rules themselves.

PROFILE_POLICY_AUTO_ADVANCE_ON_DONE_IS_B.detail: Not implemented on purpose. This rule and PROFILE_POLICY_BLOCK_KEYS_FIXED contradict each other over whether policies.autoAdvanceOnDone may exist, and enforcing either one breaks the other. Recorded in 0.13 NOT_FINAL_YET; to be decided in the review pass after implementation.

TASK_WORKFLOW_IS_DRAFT_TEMPLATE_NOT_EXEC.detail: workflow is rendered into the prompt and never enforced, which is what the rule requires, but no test asserts that it cannot become policy.

REVIEW_DECISION_ACTOR_MUST_SATISFY_RESUL.detail: requiredGates.resultReview.allowedActors is always empty and no actor is checked against it.

HARNESS_ENFORCEMENT_IS_POLICY_AND_EVIDEN.detail: path policy is enforced from the derived effectivePolicy rather than the Task, but no test asserts the boundary as the rule states it.

CODEFLEET_DURABLE_FILE_MAP_IS_LAYERED_CO.detail: the .codefleet layout is produced as designed, but no test asserts the layer contract itself.

MINIMUM_CLI_FLOW_PRESERVES_FINAL_BOUNDAR.detail: the command set exists, but only one CLI test runs and it covers --workspace on status.

IMPLEMENTATION_SLICING_MUST_PRESERVE_FIN.detail: a rule about how implementation slices are chosen, not about runtime behaviour. It constrains the plan, and the plan is a document.

MANUAL_SPINE_PASS_IS_EVIDENCE_CHECKLIST.detail: a rule about how a manual verification pass is recorded. Its artifact is the dated pass document.

V0_2_CODEX_SLICE_MUST_NOT_WEAKEN_FINAL_S.detail: a constraint on what the v0.2 slice is allowed to change in the design, enforced by review of the design document rather than at runtime.
